newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Armed robbers attack Swiss train, snatch mail.
newsitem.headline: Armed robbers attack Swiss train, snatch mail.

text.p: Five armed robbers commandeered a Swiss Intercity train on route to Geneva from Zurich late on Wednesday and stole 20 mail bags of unknown value, Swiss police said.
No one was injured in the attack and police have no clues as to the whereabouts or identities of the robbers, a spokesman for the cantonal police in Lausanne said.

At about 2130 GMT on Wednesday two hooded robbers broke into the train's locomotive and forced the driver to bring the train to a halt shortly after it had passed through a tunnel between Berne and Lausanne.

While the driver was handcuffed to a railing in the locomotive, three other robbers broke into the postal carriage at the end of the train where they handcuffed a 33-year-old postal worker to a bench.
The robbers then jumped off the train with around 20 sacks of mail and fled through vineyards to getaway cars parked nearby.
The train later continued to Lausanne, where it arrived two hours late.
